task: Making smoked salmon and dill cream crostini
query: How do I make smoked salmon and dill cream crostini?

goal.title: Prepare salmon toast with herb cream-cheese spread
goal.description: Set two bread slices on a lined plate and heat them in the combination oven. Unwrap cream cheese and spoon some into a metal bowl, add chopped green herbs, salt and small additions of liquid from a brown bottle, then stir into a spread. Remove the warm bread using oven mitts, spread both slices with the herb mixture and top them with separated orange salmon slices. Cut the topped toast and lift a piece toward the mouth.
goal.final_state: Both bread slices are coated with herb cream cheese and topped with salmon. The toast is cut and a piece is lifted for tasting.
procedure: Place two bread slices in the combination oven and set its controls.
Unwrap cream cheese and transfer portions to the mixing bowl.
Add chopped herbs, salt and bottled liquid, then mix thoroughly.
Remove the bread with oven mitts and spread the herb cheese onto both slices.
Separate salmon slices, arrange them over the bread, cut and taste the toast.

phases.description: Take two slices from the bag, place them on the lined plate, load the plate into the combination oven and repeatedly set its controls before leaving it heating.
Bring forward the bowl and measuring spoon, open the cream-cheese box and foil, scoop portions into the bowl, and rewrap the remaining cheese.
Use the knife and spoon to scrape chopped herbs into the bowl. Add salt from the blue-topped container and measure small liquid additions using the brown bottle cap, then close the bottle.
Stir the mixture with the knife, briefly mark a handwritten checklist, then stir thoroughly until the visible herbs are distributed through the cheese. Put the bowl down.
Inspect and wait at the oven, open it and put on oven mitts. Remove the plate, close the oven, set the mitts aside and open the salmon container.
Lift the first bread slice, scoop and smooth the herb cheese over it, and place it on the small plate. Repeat on the second slice.
Take salmon slices from the container, peel the overlapping pieces apart and arrange them across both coated bread slices. Return a small remaining piece to the container.
Cut through the salmon-topped bread using the knife, adjust the plate and lift a topped piece toward the mouth. The final piece has a bite missing.
